A Thevenin load (0.9·VDD, 600 Ω) centres vout near 0.9 V for swing. Cs is chosen so its zero cancels the output pole, which pushes f3db to (1+gmRs)·fo ≈ 1.2 GHz. PARAMS = {
    "W1":   (44.0, 15.0, 120.0),      # input NMOS width [um]
    "L1":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.30),       # input NMOS length [um]
    "Rs":   (210.0, 100.0, 450.0),    # source degeneration [ohm]
    "Ru":   (667.0, 450.0, 1000.0),   # load resistor to VDD
    "Rd":   (6000.0, 3000.0, 15000.0),# load resistor to VSS (Thevenin 0.9*VDD)
    "Rtop": (8000.0, 4000.0, 16000.0),# gate level-shift resistor to VDD
    "Rbot": (2200.0, 1000.0, 4000.0), # vin -> gate resistor
    "Cb":   (1.0e-12, 3e-13, 3e-12),  # bypass across Rbot (HF gain -> ~1)
    "Cs":   (1.8e-12, 6e-13, 5e-12),  # source peaking cap (zero cancels output pole)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 2e-5)
    W1, L1, Rs = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["Rs"]
    Ru, Rd, Rtop, Rbot = p["Ru"], p["Rd"], p["Rtop"], p["Rbot"]
    Cb, Cs = p["Cb"], p["Cs"]

    def solve(model, vdd):
        g = vin + (vdd - vin) * Rbot / (Rtop + Rbot)
        vdiv = vdd * Rd / (Ru + Rd)
        rth = Ru * Rd / (Ru + Rd)
        lo, hi = 0.0, max(g - 0.25, 0.01)
        op = None
        for _ in range(48):
            vs = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            vd = vdiv - 0.5
            for _k in range(4):
                op = model.op("n", W1, L1, g - vs, max(vd - vs, 0.05), vs)
                vd = vdiv - op["Id"] * rth
            if op["Id"] - vs / Rs > 0:
                lo = vs
            else:
                hi = vs
        Id = vs / Rs
        vout = vdiv - Id * rth
        return dict(g=g, vs=vs, Id=Id, vout=vout, vdiv=vdiv, rth=rth, op=op)

    s = solve(lut, 1.8)
    op = s["op"]
    gm, gds = op["gm"], op["gds"]
    gmb = 0.2 * gm
    cgg = op["cgg"]
    rth = s["rth"]

    # output node capacitance: CL + drain junction/overlap of M1 (estimate)
    cdd = 0.8e-15 * W1 + 0.35 * cgg
    ctot = cl + cdd

    # numerical small-signal transfer
    k_lf = Rtop / (Rtop + Rbot)
    fs = np.logspace(5, 10.5, 600)
    H = []
    for f in fs:
        sj = 2j * PI * f
        zbot = Rbot / (1 + sj * Rbot * Cb)
        ztop = Rtop / (1 + sj * Rtop * 0.5 * cgg)
        kin = ztop / (ztop + zbot)
        zs = Rs / (1 + sj * Rs * Cs)
        Gm = gm / (1 + (gm + gmb + gds) * zs)
        rout_m = (1 + (gm + gmb) * zs) / gds
        zl = 1.0 / (1.0 / rth + 1.0 / rout_m + sj * ctot)
        H.append(abs(kin * Gm * zl))
    H = np.array(H)
    A0 = H[0]
    f3 = fs[-1]
    for i in range(len(fs)):
        if H[i] < A0 / math.sqrt(2):
            f3 = fs[i]
            break
    gain_db = 20 * math.log10(max(A0, 1e-9))

    # swing estimate: between M1 triode edge and cutoff (Vdiv)
    vth = op["vth"]
    v_low = s["g"] + 0.15 - vth
    v_high = min(s["vdiv"] - 0.05, s["vout"] + A0 * 0.3)
    swing = max(0.0, min(v_high, s["vout"] + 0.6 * A0) - max(v_low, s["vout"] - 0.6 * A0))

    i_load = (1.8 - s["vout"]) / Ru
    i_div = (1.8 - vin) / (Rtop + Rbot)
    power = 1.8 * (i_load + i_div + iref)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "g", "s", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.R("RS", "s", "vss", Rs)
    n.C("CS", "s", "vss", Cs)
    n.R("RU", "vdd", "vout", Ru)
    n.R("RD", "vout", "vss", Rd)
    n.R("RTOP", "vdd", "g", Rtop)
    n.R("RBOT", "vin", "g", Rbot)
    n.C("CB", "vin", "g", Cb)
    # IREF sink (diode-connected, otherwise unused)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 1.0)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": gain_db,
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": A0 * f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": s["vout"],
        "swing": swing,
    }
